text:
```yaml
name: Docker Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Docker
        uses: docker/setup-docker-action@v4
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: xiangpenghao/liquid-cache:${{ github.ref_name }}
```

This workflow will run on every push to a tag matching `v*.*.*`, which is typically used for releases. It sets up Docker, builds the Docker image using the current directory as the context, and pushes it to Docker Hub with the tag corresponding to the Git tag being pushed.
